blurb: Guests throw axes in a licensed venue serving beer, wine, and cider. Experiences include group events for 4-150+ people lasting 1.5 to 2 hours, social throwing sessions for up to 6 people for 1 hour, and 7-week competitive leagues. The facility requires closed toe shoes and a shirt allowing full range of motion.
extraNote: Cashless facility; debit or credit cards only · Last bookings start one hour before closing · 2 Union Square, Somerville, MA 02143
